end.parentNote: Aryan practised identifying geometric figures by their endpoints, arrows and fixed length. They used pencil and table edges as examples and correctly explained that a line remains infinite even when drawn longer or shorter. There was a mix-up about a ray having two endpoints; they later stated that a ray has one starting point and extends in one direction, though this was not marked as fully corrected. At home, ask them to draw one segment, one line and one ray, then label the endpoints and arrows.
